item.title: Spotlight on pdfly, the Swiss Army knife for PDF files
item.description:
📝 Example: $ pdfly meta minimal-document. pdfly includes some commands to pull out specific content from PDF files: pdfly extract-images & pdfly extract-annotated-text. pdfly rotate rotate specific pages of a document.
